PG: It is a pity that findings are over-interpreted and ‘dramatic’ spins are put on data. What the study says is that gastrointestinal issues caused by wheat in their group of volunteers with Irritable Bowel Syndrome isn't caused by the gluten that's in the wheat but by something else in the wheat. AND the team of scientists who studied that group of people with Irritable Bowel Syndrome + self-diagnosed non-celiac gluten sensitivity (NCGS) also concluded - in another study that was NOT promoted by the media - that gluten has psychological effects: it increases depression.

Rooms of death. Catacombs. Crypts. Acres and acres of human corpses, slowly rotting.

When they were bombarded with orbital nukes, the invaders thought them extinct. Humans can't survive being hit with a bomb, and those that didn't, should've died to radiation. But many of them escaped to their holes. Their tunnels. Their subways and metros, their bunkers and silos. Their crypts and catacombs. There wasn't a peep of life left on the earth, aside from microscopic lifeforms, and even those were killed off in huge areas.

The invaders, they moved on, mined their asteroid belts, and left their system.

But humans. They survived in their tunnels. Survived on whatever crops they managed to bring with them. Fuel for generators. Nuclear power plants feed most of the world through automated systems rerouting past damaged areas. Water was purified. And slowly, humanity grew to live with the radiation. They slowly went back to their old ways. Fighting as always. Following religious leaders. Trying to make it in their fucked up, irradiated world.
